content: ATGM336H (AT6558 SoC) supports GGA/GLL/GSA/GSV/VTG/RMC/ZDA/GNS. In multi-constellation mode it emits combined GNRMC/GNGGA (talker GN); if configured GPS-only, emits GPRMC/GPGGA. GSV sentences can appear with a non-standard BD prefix (BeiDou-specific satellite-in-view listing), distinct from the standard GN/GP/GB talker pattern used for RMC/GGA.
